shortdesc.ph: Callback for retrieving the raw audio frame for playback.
Gets the raw audio frame for playback.

p.codeblock: public abstract boolean onPlaybackAudioFrame(String channelId, int type, int samplesPerChannel, int bytesPerSample, int channels, int samplesPerSec, ByteBuffer buffer, long renderTimeMs, int avsync_type);

section.p:
You can set the audio data format in one of the following two ways:
Method 1: Call to set the audio data format, and then call to register the audio frame observer. The SDK calculates the sampling interval based on the parameters and triggers this callback accordingly.
Method 2: Call to register the audio frame observer, and then set the audio data format in the return value of the callback. The SDK calculates the sampling interval based on the return value of the callback and triggers this callback accordingly.
section.note: The settings of take precedence over . If you use Method 1 to set the audio data format, the settings in Method 2 will be ignored.
section.p:
To ensure that the data format of audio frame for playback is as expected, Agora recommends that you choose one of the following two methods to set the audio data format:
Method 1: After calling to set the audio data format and to register the audio frame observer object, the SDK calculates the sampling interval according to the parameters set in the methods, and triggers the callback according to the sampling interval.
Method 2: After calling to register the audio frame observer object, set the audio data format in the return value of the callback. The SDK then calculates the sampling interval according to the return value of the callback, and triggers the callback according to the sampling interval.

ul.li: The priority of method 1 is higher than that of method 2. If method 1 is used to set the audio data format, the setting of method 2 is invalid.
Due to framework limitations, this callback does not support sending processed audio data back to the SDK.

plentry.pd: Number of bytes per audio sample. For example, each PCM audio sample typically occupies 16 bits (2 bytes).

Number of channels:
1: Mono.
2: Stereo. For stereo, the data is interleaved.
Audio buffer. Buffer size = samplesPerChannel × channels × bytesPerSample.

Timestamp of the external audio frame (in milliseconds). You can use this parameter to synchronize audio and video frames in scenarios involving video or audio (including scenarios with external video sources).
